claims.text: Positional-restriction recovery at Indus shape, re-measured at the realistic restriction levels ρ = 0.95 and ρ = 0.90 under the I-1 simulation machinery, returns the registered verdict (POSITIVE, NEGATIVE, or INDETERMINATE) as the mechanical consequence of the cycle-2 registration's R2 rule at the strictest measurable level ρ*, with two implementations in exact agreement. Does not establish: a POSITIVE verdict licenses reading Indus positional facts only at level ρ* with the measured error terms; it establishes nothing about what any Indus mark means or what language, if any, the corpus encodes.

falsification_tests: The verdict is not the mechanical consequence of the registered rule (a recomputation from the filed per-replication values under the registered rule returns a different verdict), or the two implementations disagree on any ground-truth set or per-replication count.
